title: Matching transformations and visual-job derivation
purpose: Audit how Matching turns a validated StoryPackage into review tasks and a template-neutral visual job, and name the earliest transformation at which correct meaning is lost.

method.approach: A replay harness imported the production module pipeline/storypackage_splitter.py and called its real internals (_split_claim_segments, _semantic_units, _presentation_operations, _primary_operation, _derived_job) over the committed adapter outputs for two packages, capturing every stage's input and output per unit. No production file was modified and the harness lives outside the repository.
method.fidelityCheck: The harness replicates build()'s materialize test (storypackage_splitter.py:362-387) and its covered-claim exclusion, and reproduces production task counts EXACTLY: 307 matching-derived units for future-volksgeist against 307 in reports/storypackage-02-future-volksgeist-v13-task-proposals.json, and 185 for jayz-drake against 185. Total 492 replayed units.
method.divergenceOracle: CORRECTED. Every divergence now names an explicit oracle and no trace is labeled failure without a non-empty supported divergence. Four oracles are used. (1) The editor-designated gold reference, available for 306 of 492 units, where a differing operation set or job is a divergence. (2) Story same-task evidence: an obligation listing two or more mustBePerceptible facts across more than one claim, whose claims the grouping split. (3) The text itself, where an operation fired on a bare substring that never occurs as a word. (4) Nothing else. Continuity groups, shared-resource obligations, multi-operation primary selection and editorial-lane tension are recorded as INFORMATIONAL and explicitly not failures, because no oracle establishes the chosen behaviour is wrong.
method.harnessCorrectionMade: A first harness run indexed advisory job proposals by a beatId key that jobProposals do not carry, which made every unit look matching-derived. That was a harness bug, not a finding. It was corrected by replicating build()'s real indexing through claims[claimId]['beatId'], after which the harness matched production counts exactly and 27 units correctly showed a Story advisory job.
method.oraclesDeliberatelyNotUsed: A keyword fallback is not treated as failure. concept_statement and assert_without_data are low-specificity but not defective, and the gold reference agrees with them far more often than not. The unattributed editor corpus (Job 3 UE-22) is not used as an oracle anywhere.
method.traceIdentity: Traces are keyed by a composite story::taskId. taskId alone is not unique across packages; uniqueness of the composite key is asserted over all 492 units.

stageTrace.measurement: Claim-by-claim comparison of each audited StoryPackage against its adapter output. future-volksgeist@5: 502 claims in, 502 out, 0 missing, 0 extra, and 0 differences on text, span, lane, entityRefs, values or cohortRefs. jayz-drake-settle-it@4: 222 claims in, 222 out, 0 differences on the same six fields, including all 50 claims carrying structured values and both carrying cohortRefs. Obligations 42/42 and 6/6, continuity 2/2 and 4/4, jobProposals 20/20 and 14/14 all preserved.
stageTrace.conclusion: The adapter is not the divergent stage for any failure class. Whatever meaning is lost downstream was present and correct in the adapter output. This matters for attribution: Job 3's finding that the handoff schema cannot carry a magnitude is a CONTRACT gap, and it is NOT accompanied by an adapter that drops data it was given.
stageTrace.correctedEarlierReading: An intermediate reading of a single claim's key set suggested the adapter dropped values and cohortRefs. That was wrong: the first claim simply had neither. The union of adapter claim keys includes values and cohortRefs, and the per-claim comparison above shows zero loss.

stageTrace.verdict: CONTRIBUTING DEFECT SITE - 7 of 99 first divergences (revised down from 43)
stageTrace.splitFinding: _split_claim_segments contains exactly ONE split rule: a regex for a comma followed by 'but also' where 'not just' appears earlier in the claim (lines 169-172). Every other claim returns unchanged as a single segment with strongBoundary false. No other scope expansion, contrast, enumeration or clause boundary can ever split a claim.
stageTrace.groupingFinding: _semantic_units merges adjacent segments when same_payload holds, whose decisive term is _primary_operation(prior) == _primary_operation(current) (line 215). Grouping is therefore driven by the keyword-derived operation label. The entity term accepts either a shared display entity OR BOTH UNITS HAVING NO display entity (line 218), so entity-less claims merge freely up to the 260-character cap.
stageTrace.structuralProof: The signature is _semantic_units(*, beat, claim_ids, claims). Obligations and continuity are never passed in, so grouping provably cannot consider them. They are attached afterwards by set intersection against already-fixed claim_ids (lines 334-338, 438-439). This is the airtight form of Job 2's observation.
stageTrace.measuredConsequence: REVISED. 7 units split a same-task obligation, meaning an obligation that lists two or more mustBePerceptible facts across more than one claim. The clearest case remains o-formula-flip, whose two claims state the same chart history producing two different winners under two counting rules and which must be co-perceptible for the point to land; the grouping emitted them as two tasks. The 26 continuity splits reported in the published version are WITHDRAWN: no continuity group in either package asserts same-task membership.

stageTrace.verdict: PRIMARY DEFECT SITE - 92 of 99 first divergences
stageTrace.inferenceFinding: _presentation_operations is entirely hardcoded substring matching over lowered text, with 13 operation families and roughly 120 literal terms. From the claim rows it reads only entityRefs (display required/eligible), values and cohortRefs. It never reads lane, obligations, continuity, span or provenance, although lane is present on every claim row it receives.

The gold reference assigns concept_statement alone to 103 of the 107 such units it shares, and the same job to all 107. The fallback is therefore largely the same call the perfect reference makes, and only the 4 gold-disagreeing cases are counted as divergences. stageTrace.verdict: DERIVATIVE - inherits the operation defect rather than adding one
stageTrace.finding: _derived_job is a short priority ladder over the operation set plus values, cohorts and entity counts. It adds no new keyword surface except a four-term define_terms test. Because its first test is rhetorical_question and its last line is a bare assert_without_data return, its output is almost entirely determined by whether the keyword layer fired.

stageTrace.valueBlindnessTest: Tested and NOT confirmed as a defect. Every unit carrying structured Story values received a value-bearing job (derived_quantity, parallel_instances or proportion_of_cohort); zero units with values fell through to a non-value job. The value branches work where values exist. They are simply unreachable for future-volksgeist, whose package carries no values at all, which is a Story authoring gap already owned as Job 3 G-05.

stageTrace.stage: Entity, value, cohort, obligation and continuity propagation
stageTrace.verdict: PROPAGATION IS SOUND; CONSUMPTION IS PARTIAL
stageTrace.finding: Propagation into the task row is faithful: entityRefs, values, cohortRefs, lanes, obligations, continuity and reviewKeys are all attached. Downstream, presentation_contract DOES consume obligations, deriving needsOnScreenText, wouldBeALie and mustBePerceptible from them (visualtask_matching.py:60-66, 88-91), and it consumes values and cohortRefs for its quantitative test.
stageTrace.refinementOfJob2: This refines rather than repeats Job 2. Obligations are not globally ignored by Matching: they shape the presentation contract. What they never shape is the GROUPING that decides what a task is, because _semantic_units is not given them. Lane, by contrast, is present on every claim row handed to _presentation_operations and is read by nothing in either module.
stageTrace.resolvesUE14: Job 3 UE-14 asked whether Matching consumes showTogether, continuityGroupIds and focal. Answer: NO for all three. Each has zero occurrences in both storypackage_splitter.py and storypackage_adapter.py. continuity is consumed as a flat claim-id list, never as the handoff's continuityGroupIds; showTogether and focal are never read anywhere in the transformation path.

primaryOperationSuppressionTest.theSplitModule: pipeline/visualtask_split_proposals.py implements a keep_single / split recommendation, but it reads neither mixedPayloadReviewRequired nor presentationOperations, it is ungated and not a declared entrypoint (Job 1 AF-03), it is imported only by heldout_matching_integration.py, and no split-proposal artifact exists in reports/. primaryOperationSuppressionTest.conclusion: The flag is written and never read. The promised route/split alternative does not exist at this baseline, so the single-primary admission rule suppresses secondary operations with no effective mitigation. The published report's statements that the route 'works' and that the rule is 'fully endorsed' are WITHDRAWN. Whether necessary meaning is thereby lost cannot be demonstrated from this baseline, because there is no consumer whose behaviour could be observed; it is recorded unresolved.
primaryOperationSuppressionTest.whatIsStillTrue: The full presentationOperations list is preserved in the artifact, 310 of 310 in both the gold reference and current output, so nothing is discarded at the artifact level. And the risk the code comment names is real and measured: 61 percent of event_narration firings rest only on a generic term, 95 of them on the substring 'was ', so a union over inferred operations would admit unrelated families on noise.
primaryOperationSuppressionTest.proposalDiscipline: No unrelated-family union is proposed. Per the correction request, the alternatives evaluated are a coherent task split, corrected primary selection, and an existing route.

OPERATION_PRIORITY is a fixed global tuple (UE-23) so the winner is whichever family ranks highest, not whichever the sentence is about. Raising keyword precision first (P4-1) removes most spurious candidates for primacy, after which a corrected order can be evaluated against the gold reference's operation sets, which already disagree with current on 88 of 309 tasks.

proposals.change: Match terms on word boundaries rather than bare substrings, and remove or qualify generic grammatical terms that carry no visual signal.
proposals.evidence: 6 lexical false positives proven from the text itself, and the measured generic-term rates: event_narration 61 percent, archival_progression 41 percent, milestone_reveal 29 percent.
proposals.expectedEffect: raises operation precision; does not widen admission arity
proposals.whyMinimal: term matching and term membership only; no new family, field, or change to admission arity

proposals.target: pipeline/storypackage_splitter.py _semantic_units signature and call site (NOT EDITED, proposal only)
proposals.supersedes: the published P4-2, which treated any obligation or continuity group as proof of single-task membership
proposals.change: Consult obligation and continuity membership BEFORE grouping, and classify each group rather than collapsing it. (a) SAME-TASK evidence: an obligation listing two or more mustBePerceptible facts across more than one claim; those claims are candidates for one task. (b) LINKED-TASKS evidence: a continuity group, identified by its scope and strength fields, which asserts treatment consistency across separate moments; emit a linkedTaskGroup annotation and DO NOT join. (c) SHARED-RESOURCE evidence: an obligation spanning several moments with fewer than two mustBePerceptible facts, such as one source clip across several claims; annotate and do not join. (d) Record the reason for every join and every split. (e) A join remains subject to the existing coherent-moment payload cap: where a join would exceed it, emit a linked task set carrying the co-perceptibility note instead of one oversized task.
proposals.whyMinimal: The discriminating data already exists in the adapter output and is already attached to tasks after grouping. This passes it one stage earlier and reads two fields that are already present. It proposes no new contract field, which is why it is not a Job 3 gap.

counterexampleResults.verdict: Both required counterexamples pass. The revised rule preserves every coherent visual-moment boundary in the six continuity groups, does not force any group into an oversized task, records a reason for every decision, and its one aggressive case is bounded by the payload cap.

storyProposalsVersusMatchingDerivedOpera.acceptanceRequirement: The audit must distinguish Story-provided jobProposals from Matching-derived presentation operations.
storyProposalsVersusMatchingDerivedOpera.theyAreDifferentObjects: A Story jobProposal is an authored object in the StoryPackage carrying claimIds, job, proposalId and provenance. A Matching presentation operation is a label inferred inside Matching by keyword matching over claim text. They meet at exactly one place: storypackage_splitter.py:469-470, where a single unambiguous advisory job replaces the keyword-derived job.

measuredFate.materializeTest: storypackage_splitter.py:367-372. A proposal becomes its own task only if it has a span, or covers more than one claim, or shares a claim with another proposal, or its beat carries more than one distinct proposed job, or it covers the whole beat. A single-claim, span-less, unique, beat-unambiguous proposal is demoted.
measuredFate.productionCorroboration: future-volksgeist v13: 307 of 310 tasks have provenance source matching_semantic_split and the other 3 are validated_speaker_role, not job proposals. jayz-drake v13: 185 of 186 matching_semantic_split, 1 story_writer.

storyProposalsVersusMatchingDerivedOpera.theDecisiveMeasurement: 27 units received their job from a Story advisory proposal. In 0 of those 27 did the advisory job differ from the keyword-derived job. The override is therefore a no-op on the current corpus: Story's job advice never changes an output value.
storyProposalsVersusMatchingDerivedOpera.whyItIsStructuralNotLuck: Every jobProposal in both packages proposes pose_a_question. _derived_job returns pose_a_question whenever rhetorical_question is in the operation set, and that operation fires on the presence of '?' in the text. Story proposes a question job for question sentences, and the keyword layer independently detects the question mark, so they always agree. Story's advice carries no information the keyword layer does not already have.
storyProposalsVersusMatchingDerivedOpera.conclusion: The visual job in the current output is, with one exception in one package, a Matching-derived keyword artefact. Story's jobProposals are not overridden by a competing judgment; they are structurally redundant as authored. This is consistent with Job 2's finding that proposals are advisory and incomplete, and it is now established at the level of code and corpus.
storyProposalsVersusMatchingDerivedOpera.attribution: Shared in cause, separable in ownership. That 33 of 34 proposals are demoted is a Matching rule (the materialize test). That the proposals carry only pose_a_question is a Story authoring choice. Neither layer alone produces the outcome.

resolvedFromPriorJobs.finding: showTogether, focal, continuityGroupIds and mustBeTrue have ZERO occurrences in both storypackage_splitter.py and storypackage_adapter.py. None is consumed anywhere in the transformation path. continuity is consumed, but as a flat claim-id list attached after grouping, never as the handoff's grouped continuityGroupIds.

Job 4 confirms Matching cannot derive relation sides from what it receives: _presentation_operations infers comparison from a term list plus a bare count of display entities (len(refs) >= 2) and never models sides or direction. But this remains a single-story-evidenced hypothesis, so the Job 3 demotion stands. Job 4 adds mechanism, not cross-story recurrence.

The adjacency need shows up here as a GROUPING problem rather than a contract problem. Continuity groups already enumerate the claims that belong together, and the defect is that the grouping function is never given them (proposal P4-2). A new adjacency contract field is not required to fix the 26 observed continuity fragmentations.

Operations inferred per task, gold versus current v13 for future-volksgeist: gold is {1: 269, 2: 32, 3: 7, 4: 2}; current is {1: 215, 2: 71, 3: 17, 4: 6, 5: 1}. The current keyword set fires materially more often than whatever produced the gold, which is consistent with term-list growth between the two revisions. This is evidence about relative trigger behaviour, not an identification of the revision, so UE-08 is advanced rather than closed.

input.unitText: There's a reason why Future not only created the pop trap wave, but he also outlived it.
But resonating with the mainstream was also what he needed. Future's debut album, Pluto, was commercial, but it also wasn't. I wouldn't say he was chasing the radio; I would say he was waving at it.
In early 2014, his doubters' predictions almost came true. His second album, Honest, was trash. Future kept saying he never chases the radio, but Honest was at the very least jogging towards it.

unresolvedEvidence.item: Mixed-payload handling is unresolved. mixedPayloadReviewRequired has zero read-sites, the produced route vocabulary has no split route, and the split module is unwired. Whether single-primary admission loses necessary meaning cannot be demonstrated at this baseline because no consumer behaviour can be observed.
OPERATION_PRIORITY is a fixed global tuple with no stated derivation.

The roughly 120 literal terms in _presentation_operations have no recorded provenance, which limits how confidently the list can be pruned. The gold reference now provides a partial oracle: it disagrees with current operation sets on 88 of 309 tasks.

year-seventeen has no committed adapter output in this checkout, so its path could not be replayed and it is absent from these measurements. It is also the package whose gold reference exists, so a second gold oracle is unavailable.
The gold reference covers only future-volksgeist, so the gold oracle is available for 306 of 492 replayed units. The 186 jayz-drake units rest on the Story and lexical oracles alone.

result_detail.headline: Corrected. The primary defect site is the hardcoded operation inference, not the grouping step, and the promised mixed-payload route does not exist.
result_detail.oneLine: Measured against the editor's own perfect reference, the operation layer agrees on 71 percent of operation sets and 90 percent of jobs, so the fallback it was accused of overusing is mostly right; what is wrong is 87 operation-set disagreements, 6 operations fired on substrings that are not words, 7 co-perceptibility requirements split apart, and a mixed-payload flag that nothing reads.

correctionRequest.accepted: in full; all three findings were correct, and applying them exposed two further defects of my own

corrections.request: Four traces were labeled failure while carrying an empty divergences list and a null firstDivergentStage.
corrections.action: Every trace is now re-diagnosed against an explicit named oracle, and no trace can be labeled failure without a non-empty supported divergence. Resolution of the four: jayz-drake::matching-derived-p02-3-06 stays a FAILURE with a lexical oracle (milestone_reveal fired on the bare substring "ready", which occurs only inside "already"); future-volksgeist::matching-derived-p01-1-04 and -p01-1-05 are RECLASSIFIED SUCCESS because the editor-designated gold reference assigns exactly the same operation set and job; future-volksgeist::matching-derived-p01-4-02 stays a FAILURE with a gold oracle, gold ["data_explanation"] against current ["concept_statement"]. All aggregates were recomputed from the corrected trace set.

corrections.request: The audit must not treat a keyword fallback as failure without an oracle, and concept_statement / assert_without_data is not automatically unusable.
corrections.action: Withdrawn, and the measurement reversed. Of 107 current concept_statement-only tasks with a gold counterpart, the gold reference ALSO assigns concept_statement alone in 103 (96 percent), and assigns the SAME job in 107 of 107 (100 percent). The earlier framing that 177 units carried a semantic-null job "purely because no keyword matched" implied a defect that the evidence does not support. Only the 4 gold-disagreeing cases are now counted as divergences. No claim of harmful downstream behaviour is made anywhere for this class.

corrections.request: The suppression test proved the flag is emitted, not that any consumer acts on it.
corrections.action: Traced and WITHDRAWN. mixedPayloadReviewRequired has exactly one occurrence in code, the line that writes it (storypackage_splitter.py:302); it has ZERO read-sites anywhere in pipeline/. preferredTreatment likewise has zero read-sites, while its siblings templateEligible and brollFallbackAvailable have 3 and 9. The produced route vocabulary contains only template_review (64) and broll (18): there is no split route. matching_agent._route_plan computes the route from templateEligible and candidate presence alone, so a mixed-payload task receives exactly the same route as any other. A split module exists (visualtask_split_proposals.py) but it reads neither the flag nor presentationOperations, is ungated and undeclared per Job 1 AF-03, is imported only by the held-out evaluation path, and has produced no committed artifact. Conclusion withdrawn: route/split handling for mixed payloads is NOT implemented, the endorsement of the single-primary rule is withdrawn, and handling is recorded unresolved as UE-26.

corrections.request: P4-2 must not make obligation and continuity groups automatically atomic.
corrections.action: Accepted; the original P4-2 was wrong in exactly the way described. The adapter rows carry the discriminator and the original proposal ignored it. Continuity rows carry scope and strength: the six groups across both packages use scope template_family, template, visual_grammar and subject_framing, all at strength preferred, and NOT ONE asserts single-task membership. g-head-to-head states the invariant "one consistent two-column head-to-head treatment FOR EVERY RAW COUNT", which is explicitly many tasks sharing one family. The original P4-2 would have forced 14 claims into one oversized task. P4-2 is revised to separate same-task evidence from linked-task evidence, and both required counterexamples were run and reported.

corrections.request: Not raised by the request; found while applying it.
corrections.action: The 26 continuity_split_across_units divergences reported in the published Job 4 are WITHDRAWN in full. They rested on treating a continuity group as same-task evidence, which the scope field disproves. They are reclassified as informational linked_tasks_continuity_group annotations. The 20 obligation_split_across_units divergences are reduced to 7 same_task_obligation_split, counting only obligations that list two or more mustBePerceptible facts across more than one claim.

corrections.action: taskId is NOT unique across packages: both future-volksgeist and jayz-drake emit a unit called matching-derived-p01-4-02, because beat ids are per-package. The published Job 4 identified traces by taskId alone, so its trace identifiers were ambiguous and an internal lookup silently collapsed two different units. Every trace now carries a composite traceKey of story::taskId, uniqueness is asserted over all 492 units, and both p01-4-02 units are included in the trace set to make the distinction visible: the future-volksgeist one is a failure and the jayz-drake one is a success.
